layer.detail: What each line is - a session, a ticket, a project. Its rows are stretches of time; the line runs from its first start to its last end.

start.detail: When each row's stretch of time starts.

end.detail: When each row's stretch of time ends.

label.detail: The name shown for a line - on it, and when pointing at it. Defaults to the Layer value.

colour.detail: Lines sharing a value share a colour - e.g. a team or a workspace. Defaults to each layer its own.

emphasis.detail: Per row, 2 strong, 1 medium, 0 faint (the default). Each pixel of a line shows the strongest stretch in it, so a moment of 2 is never lost.

momentAt.detail: Rows with a time here (and no Start or End) are moments on their line, at that time - a commit, say, appended from a table of its own - drawn as a tiny triangle above it. Rows whose Start and End are the same are moments too.

moment.detail: What kind each moment is. With this field, the commonest kind is a pinch on the line (a tiny triangle above it, its point on the line) and the next a badge with a tick (a merge, say).

foot.detail: Rows with no Layer but a value here are drawn as a heavy line along the foot - up to two values, the more frequent darker. Blank: the foot line is drawn from the lines, wherever any is strong.

order.detail: Longest-lived on top: short-lived layers slide in beneath and lift the long ones. Longest-lived at the bottom: the long ones lie flat, short-lived layers ride on top of them. Oldest at the bottom: new layers go on top.

labels.detail: Where the lines still open at the right edge are named; point at any line for its name.

intro.detail: How the view opens, the first time it loads: glide in from the whole range to about a week on the screen, or replay the whole range from left to right, or neither.

workday.detail: Under the foot line, each day's 8am-4pm with dots at 8, 12 and 4.

standup.detail: A time such as 09:30, marked on weekdays with the working-day marks.
